messages:
maria: Heads up — profiler shows a p95 spike on route /chat/stream after the kernel-selector change last night. Seeing a pattern with KV cache miss rate jump.
devin: I saw that. Raw numbers? p95 went from ~180ms to 420ms for 8k seqs, right?
maria: Exactly. Attached flame-ish dump in the thread — main diff is more frequent kernel swaps on mid-size batches, and that seems to correlate with evicting prefixes from KV more aggressively.
sam: Could be the new kernel-affinity heuristic preferring XLA-like kernels for sequences <512. Those kernels do a different KV prefetch behavior.
tess: Quick thought: continuous batcher uses token budgets per route tier. If kernel churn increases per microbatch, that increases the tail because KV warmups are serialized. We may need a cushion token budget to avoid kernel flips mid-request.
devin: Proposed quick fix: Add a per-route/window cushion of 32 tokens to the token budget target so we hold batches slightly longer and reduce kernel hammering. Thoughts?
maria: Reasonable as a canary. But we should also gate by observed kernel-change-rate metric to avoid adding latency everywhere.
sam: Agree. We can implement a heuristic: if kernel-change-rate > 0.02 (2% of minibatches switching kernel), then add cushion = min(64, 0.05 * avg_tokens).
tess: Will that increase p50? We need to keep p95 SLO, but not blow up p50 too much. Suggest running on canary routes (beta-tier routes first) with metrics tracked: p50, p95, kv-hit-rate, kernel-change-rate.
maria: I'll attach a quick flame and the perfprof lines: ```perf dump --top 50``` shows KV lock contention during kernel handoff.
devin: For rollout plan: 1) implement cushion feature behind flag; 2) enable on beta-tier routes for 1 hour; 3) compare p95 and kv-hit-rate; 4) if good, widen to gold for low-traffic nodes.
sam: Also log kernel_choice and kv_prefetch_epoch tags so we can correlate at request level. We lack those structured tags currently.
tess: I'll add the logfields patch (small PR) and the cushion flag in the batcher config. PR links once ready.
deploy-bot: deploy started: batcher/cushion-flag -> staging at 1755559000
maria: After staging run, sample shows kernel-change-rate dropped from 0.045 -> 0.007 on the canary route, kv-hit-rate +12%, p95 reduced to ~210ms (from 420ms). Early win.
devin: Nice. Let's hold on roll-forward until we've got the A/B for p50 tradeoff. If p50 rises <5% and p95 halves, sounds acceptable.
sam: Also scheduling a profiling run to see if kernel affinity thresholds need retuning rather than permanent cushion.
tess: I'll open change request for gradual rollout and add throttles: cushion only engages when queue_wait_time < X and current_batch_size > 1.
maria: Thanks — will update the incident board with the experimental results and link PRs. If anyone needs the raw profiler traces, ping me.
